name: salliha
description: صليها — Salliha: تطبيق إسلامي مجاني، بلا إعلانات، يعمل بدون إنترنت، بمواقيت صلاة لكل دول العالم.

scripts.build: npm run data:build && npm run validate:quran && npm run validate:data && npm run lint && vite build
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-cap-platform.mjs android && npx cap sync android && node scripts/build-icons.mjs && npm run native:permissions && npm run native:adhan
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-cap-platform.mjs ios && npx cap sync ios && npm run native:permissions && npm run native:adhan
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:simulator: npm run cap:ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.cap:prepare: node scripts/build-icons.mjs && node scripts/ensure-cap-platform.mjs android && npx cap sync android && npm run native:permissions && npm run native:adhan
